items.title: Section: Ten Virtues, the Exact Mirror of Ten Faults

items.zh: 云何名為王之功德？大王當知！王功德者略有十種。王若成就如是功德，雖無大府庫、無大輔佐、無大軍眾，而可歸仰。何等為十？一、種姓尊高，二、得大自在，三、性不暴惡，四、憤發輕微，五、恩惠猛利，六、受正直言，七、所作諦思善順儀則，八、顧戀善法，九、善知差別知所作恩，十、不自縱任不行放逸。云何名王種姓尊高？謂有國王，處在相似王家而生，宿世尊貴，是相似子。如是名王種姓尊高。云何名王得大自在？謂有國王，自隨所欲作所應作，勞賚群臣，於妙五欲歡娛遊戲，於諸大臣、輔相、國師、群官等所，凡出教命，宣布無礙。如是名王得大自在。云何名王性不暴惡？謂有國王，諸群臣等隨於何處，雖行增上不如意事，性能容忍，不現擯黜，不發麁言，亦不咆勃，廣說乃至不生憤發，亦不背面而作前事，亦不內意祕匿忿纏，亦不長夜蓄怨憤心，相續不捨。不現暴惡、不背暴惡、不匿暴惡、不久暴惡。如是名王性不暴惡。
items.en: What is called a king's virtue? Great King, you should know that a king's virtues are, in brief, of ten kinds. If a king possesses such virtues, though he lacks a great treasury, great ministers, and a great army, he yet deserves reliance. What are the ten? First, noble lineage. Second, great sovereign authority. Third, freedom from cruelty. Fourth, mild anger. Fifth, abundant kindness. Sixth, heeding honest counsel. Seventh, acting with careful thought and in accordance with protocol. Eighth, valuing wholesome dharma. Ninth, skilfully distinguishing and remembering kindness received. Tenth, freedom from heedless self-indulgence. What is called a king's noble lineage? A king born into a truly eminent royal house, resembling the true heir. This is called noble lineage. What is called a king's great sovereign authority? A king able to act, reward his ministers, and enjoy the finest pleasures according to his own wish, every command to his ministers carried out without obstruction. This is called great sovereign authority. A king whose ministers, wherever they act in a genuinely displeasing way, meets with patience and tolerance, neither banishing them to their face, nor speaking coarsely, nor erupting in anger, down through never harbouring secret resentment nor nursing a grudge across a long stretch of time. Not displaying cruelty openly, behind the back, in secret, or over a long time. This is called freedom from cruelty.

items.title: Section: A Punishment Scaled to the Actual Fault

items.zh: 云何名王憤發輕微？謂有國王，諸群臣等雖有大愆、有大違越，而不一切削其封祿、奪其妻妾，不以重罰而刑罰之，隨過輕重而行黜罰。如是名王憤發輕微。云何名王恩惠猛利？謂有國王，諸群臣等正直現前供奉侍衛，其心清淨、其心調順，於時時中，以正圓滿軟言慰諭；具足頒錫爵祿、勳庸，而不令彼損耗、稽留、劬勞、怨恨；易可供奉，不難承事。如是名王恩惠猛利。云何名王受正直言？謂有國王，諸群臣等實有聰叡，無聰叡慢，無濁無偏，善閑憲式，情無違叛，樂修善法，聽受信用如是輩人所進言議，由此因緣，國務、財寶、名稱、善法皆悉增盛。如是名王受正直言。
items.en: What is called a king's mild anger? A king whose ministers, though they commit a serious fault or overstepping, does not entirely strip their rank and salary, seize their wives and concubines, or subject them to severe punishment, but instead metes out censure proportionate to the fault. This is called mild anger. What is called a king's abundant kindness? A king whose ministers serve him with genuine sincerity, their minds pure and compliant, and who, in due season, offers correct, complete, gentle comfort, fully granting rank and reward without depletion, delay, labour, or resentment, easy to serve and not burdensome. This is called abundant kindness. What is called a king's heeding honest counsel? A king whose ministers are truly wise, free of arrogance, corruption, and bias, well versed in law, harbouring no rebellion, delighting in wholesome practice, and who trusts and heeds precisely this counsel, his governance, treasury, reputation, and wholesome practice all flourishing as a result. This is called heeding honest counsel.

items.zh: 云何名王所作諦思善順儀則？謂有國王，性能究察、能審究察、性能思擇、能審思擇諸群臣等，於彼彼務機密事中，不堪委任而不委任，堪委任者而委任之；不堪役者而不驅役，堪驅役者乃驅役之；應賞賚者而正賞賚，應刑罰者而正刑罰；凡有所為，審思審擇，然後方作，而不卒暴。又於群臣，能善安處先王儀則；由此群臣雖處宴會，終不發言間絕餘論，要待言終，恭敬畏憚而興諫諍，如其旨教而善奉行，能正安住王之教命。如是名王所作諦思善順儀則。云何名王顧戀善法？謂有國王，信知他世；由信知故，便於當來淨不淨業、愛非愛果能善信解，由信解故，具足慚恥，而不縱情作身語意三種惡行，時時思擇布施、修福、受齋、學戒。如是名王顧戀善法。云何名王善知差別知所作恩？謂有國王，於諸大臣、輔相、國師及群官等心無顛倒，能善了知忠信、伎藝、智慧差別。若諸群臣忠信、伎藝及與智慧，若有若無並如實知。於其無者輕而遠之，於其有者敬而愛之，而正攝受。

blocks.text: The ten virtues are the exact mirror of the ten faults.

Master Cháng Bǎi: though lacking a full treasury, able ministers, and many troops, such a king can be relied on by all. The treatise places virtue above resources. He has real authority: whatever he commands is done. He shows no cruelty to one's face, behind one's back, in secret, or for long. He is easy to serve and generous; his rewards are ample and prompt.
The good king's penalties are scaled to the actual fault, the reverse of the harshness on Day 545.

**Acting with thought.** The king examines his ministers: he entrusts secret matters only to the fit, rewards and punishes rightly, and acts only after reflection, never rashly; his ministers wait for others to finish before speaking, and follow his commands. **Caring for the good.** He believes in a next life, so has shame, restrains body, speech, and mind, and from time to time gives, makes merit, keeps the observance, and trains in precepts. **Discerning.** He knows truly who is loyal, skilled, and wise, keeps distance from those who are not, and honours and cares for those who are.
"Virtue above resources." A leader with little but a good character is safer to rely on than one with everything but a bad one.

quiz.q: If a king has the ten virtues but lacks treasury, ministers, and army, what does the treatise conclude?
options: he still does not, since without an army he can protect no one
only ministers may rely on him
quiz.why: This exactly reverses §2. Master Cháng Bǎi: though lacking a full treasury, able ministers, and many troops, such a king can be relied upon by all. The treatise thus places a ruler's worth in virtue, not in resources.

quiz.q: How does the treatise describe a king's 得大自在?
options: he has severed all desires and has no interest in pleasures, a yogin's state
he rewards and enjoys as he wishes, and his commands go forth without obstruction
he punishes at will without criticism
he needs no ministers at all
quiz.why: Great autonomy here is the reverse of being controlled by ministers. The treatise even includes enjoying pleasures. Master Cháng Bǎi: whatever the king commands, everyone carries it out without obstruction. It is about authority, not renunciation.

quiz.q: How does Master Cháng Bǎi summarise freedom from cruelty?
options: it is enough not to rage to one's face; what one says behind the back has no bearing
not open, not behind the back, not hidden, and not lasting, the reverse of the fault described before
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: this king shows no cruelty to one's face, behind one's back, in secret, or for long, exactly the opposite of the earlier fault. He also does not hide anger inwardly, so all four forms in §3 are answered.

quiz.q: 恩惠猛利 is rendered "forceful kindness." Compared with the lecture, what is the issue?
options: no issue: the king compels gratitude by force, so the term matches anger
猛利 answers 奢薄, meaning generous and timely, while "forceful" suggests pressure
quiz.why: Master Cháng Bǎi: such a king is easy to serve and generous in rewarding ministers. The same passage speaks of gentle comfort, so 猛利 means ample and prompt, the opposite of 奢薄, with no sense of force. "Generous" would convey it.
